questions.stem: 許多青少年已被短影音吸引，這些影片常讓他們到半夜還不想睡。
questions.answer: Many teenagers have been attracted by short videos, and these videos often keep them awake until midnight.
accepted_answers: Many teenagers have been attracted to short videos, which often keep them up until midnight.
A lot of teenagers have been drawn to short videos, and these videos often keep them awake till midnight.

questions.stem: 專家提醒，青少年應該限制自己每天看短影音的時間。
questions.answer: Experts warn that teenagers should limit the time they spend watching short videos every day.
accepted_answers: Experts remind teenagers that they should limit how much time they spend on short videos each day.
Experts remind us that teenagers should limit the amount of time they spend watching short videos every day.

patterns: that 引導的名詞子句（當 warn 的受詞）

1.explanation_zh: 「已被…吸引」是完成式被動：have been attracted by／to short videos（青少年是被吸引的一方）。後半句「這些影片常讓他們到半夜還不想睡」用 S＋keep＋O＋形容詞：these videos often keep them awake until midnight；awake 是形容詞，當受詞補語。也可以用關係代名詞 which 連接兩個子句。
evidence: 這些影片常讓他們到半夜還不想睡
1.strategy_zh: 「讓某人保持某種狀態」用 keep／make＋受詞＋形容詞；受詞補語是形容詞，不是動詞或名詞。
hints: 切成四段：許多青少年／已被短影音吸引／這些影片常讓他們／到半夜還不想睡
標的詞彙：teenager（青少年）、attract（吸引）、video（影片）、awake（醒著的）、midnight（半夜）
句型框架：S + have been + p.p. …, and S + keep + O + adj. …

2.explanation_zh: 「專家提醒」後面接一整句話，用 that 引導名詞子句當受詞：Experts warn that …（用 remind 時要先接人：remind teenagers that …）。「應該」用 should＋原形動詞。「每天看短影音的時間」是前置修飾，英文改成後位修飾：the time they spend watching short videos every day，spend＋時間＋V-ing。
evidence: 應該限制自己每天看短影音的時間
2.strategy_zh: 中文「…的＋名詞」修飾語很長時，英文把名詞放前面，修飾語用子句或片語放在後面。
hints: 切成四段：專家提醒／青少年應該／限制自己／每天看短影音的時間
標的詞彙：expert（專家）、warn（提醒）、limit（限制）、time（時間）、video（影片）
句型框架：S + warn + that + S + should + VR + the time (that) S + spend + V-ing

Many teenagers have been attracted to short videos, which often keep them up until midnight.

references: Experts warn that teenagers should limit the time they spend watching short videos every day.
Experts remind teenagers that they should limit how much time they spend on short videos each day.
Experts remind us that teenagers should limit the amount of time they spend watching short videos every day.

patterns.label_zh: that 引導的名詞子句（當 warn 的受詞）
patterns.frame: S + warn / remind sb + that + S + V

common_errors.right: Experts remind teenagers that they should
common_errors.explanation_zh: remind 後面要先接人（受詞）再接 that 子句；不接人時可用 warn that 或 point out that。
泛指專家用複數 experts，動詞 warn 不加 s。
should 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to。
「限制自己…的時間」英文直接說 limit the time they spend …，不必把「自己」譯成 themselves。

traps.explanation_zh: remind 要先接人：remind sb that …；只接 that 子句時用 warn／point out。

2.restructuring_zh: 「每天看短影音的時間」是很長的前置修飾，英文要改成「名詞＋後位修飾」：the time they spend watching short videos every day（省略關係代名詞的形容詞子句＋spend 時間 V-ing）。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.1.patterns[0]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: Many teenagers have been attracted by short videos, which often make them unwilling to go to bed even at midnight.
1.explanation_zh: 「已被……吸引」用現在完成式被動 have been attracted by；「這些影片常讓他們……」以非限定關係子句 , which 接續，避免兩個獨立子句用逗號相連；「到半夜還不想睡」譯 unwilling to go to bed even at midnight（也可 keep them up until midnight，但會失去「不想」的語意）。信心 medium 是因為後半句寫法很多。

2.translation: Experts remind teenagers that they should limit the time they spend watching short videos every day.
2.explanation_zh: 「專家提醒」用 remind + 人 + that 子句（remind 後面要有受詞，或改用 warn that）；「每天看短影音的時間」用 the time (that) they spend watching …（spend + 時間 + V-ing）。

issues_zh: 標的詞彙 awake 的 alternatives（up／sleep）沒有收 bed；但 P4 已把 unwilling to go to bed until midnight 列為可接受寫法，這個寫法本身就命中不到 awake，學生用規準認可的寫法反而少一個標的詞。本譯文 unwilling to go to bed even at midnight 因此只命中 4/5（80%，剛好在門檻）。建議 awake 的 alternatives 補 bed（go to bed），P4 也可補 even at midnight 的寫法。

problems: 第 1 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：標的詞彙 awake 的 alternatives（up／sleep）沒有收 bed；但 P4 已把 unwilling to go to bed until midnight 列為可接受寫法，這個寫法本身就命中不到 awake，學生用規準

1.translation: Many teenagers have been attracted to short videos, which often make them unwilling to go to sleep even in the middle of the night.
1.explanation_zh: 「已被…吸引」用現在完成被動 have been attracted to，強調目前的狀態；「這些影片常讓他們…」用非限定關係子句 which often make them ...；「到半夜還不想睡」可有多種譯法，我取 unwilling to go to sleep even in the middle of the night，信心稍低。

2.translation: Experts warn that teenagers should limit the amount of time they spend watching short videos every day.
2.explanation_zh: 「專家提醒」用 Experts warn that；「應該」用 should；「限制自己每天看短影音的時間」用 limit the amount of time they spend (in) watching ...，反身意義由主詞 teenagers 與 they 對應即可。

issues_zh: 備註：「半夜」最直接的英文是 in the middle of the night，我就是這樣寫的；但 midnight 的 alternatives 只有 late at night，所以我的譯文只命中 4/5 個標的詞彙（awake 是靠 alternatives 的 sleep 命中），剛好卡在 80%。建議把 the middle of the night 補進 midnight 的 alternatives，part 4 accepted 也補 even in the middle of the night。
